<thought>I will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that forms a C=C double bond and breaks a C=O and a C-O bond in the forward direction, matching the Doebner modification. This should retrieve the template used previously, whose ID I can then return along with its mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C=C"],
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C=O", "C-O"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C=C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
